sentences.en: These two lines cut across each other at right angles.
sentences.zh: 这两条线互相垂直相交。

sentences.en: He was clearly angling for a reduction on his rent.
sentences.zh: 他显然是想在房租上讨价还价。

sentences.en: Shooting from a low angle makes your legs appear longer.
sentences.zh: 从低角度拍摄可以使你的腿看起来更长。
